card.name: Verbs predicting an outcome of misuse
card.fires_on: The verb or modal right after a warning condition, such as 'will behave', 'will result', 'may cause', where the next words describe an unwanted or unexpected outcome. Also the word 'expected' itself in talk of expected output.

modes.label: Outcome verb after a condition
modes.description: A verb like behave, result, cause or look follows 'will' or 'may' and leads into a bad result.
modes.example: this function will<< behave>> unpredictably on multiprocessor x8

modes.label: Modal before a result
modes.description: The word 'will' or 'usually' sits just before a stated consequence or default behavior.
modes.example: is copied<< will>> result in errors.

modes.label: The word expected
modes.description: The word 'expected' appears in a discussion of what output or behavior is anticipated.
modes.example: to know what the<< expected>> output for a given input is.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word 'expected', as in 'behave as expected' or 'expected output'.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence where the text is about to say what happens, often 'as expected' or an unexpected result.
